summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, verified by reading only (no tests or repository code run, no commits). Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the title format entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title classmethod with docstring. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, checking only is_terminal and returning bool, with the required Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(second item). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in existing modules: test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skips on legacy_windows at runtime), test_control.py (test_control_title), test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows-only via existing marker). Docstring lines were kept within 88 characters. Nothing has been executed, so test and mypy results are unknown.
